sub_sector.value: complex generic pharmaceuticals; specialty branded and biosimilar medicines; pharmaceutical distribution

healthcare_segment.detail: Generic, specialty and biosimilar drug maker, plus AvKARE distribution of pharmaceuticals to government, retail and institutions.

product_stage.detail: Manufactures and sells hundreds of marketed medicines, including newly launched Brekiya and Crexont.

customer_payer.detail: Sells to hospitals, health systems, retail and institutional channels and U.S. federal government; patients' coverage pays.

therapeutic_area.detail: Broad generics portfolio; branded focus on central nervous system (migraine, Parkinson's) and endocrine; oncology biosimilars.
